interpretations.statement: Duplicate reactors agree closely in peak VCD in 10 of 12 experiments (EXP010: 16.07e6 vs 16.17e6 cells/mL, 0.6%; EXP012: 7.00e6 vs 7.02e6), so cultivation variability is concentrated in specific anomalous runs (EXP001, EXP011, EXP008) rather than being a general reproducibility failure.
uncertainties: Peaks are single offline samples; offline timestamps are absent from the numeric projection (row index used as time proxy).
Setpoint differences between experiment groups are from provenance-unresolved aggregates.

interpretations.statement: EXP001 duplicates diverged strongly: R01 peaked at 14.0e6 cells/mL (SEM 0.40e6) and then starved (glucose 0.16 g/L; end viability 0.28%), while R02 peaked at 8.49e6 (SEM 0.41e6) and survived to the last sample (end viability 64.5%). At the same sample index (row 10) R01 was already 2.6x higher (14.0e6 vs 5.4e6). The peak difference is roughly 20x the combined SEM (child analysis), so it is not offline counting noise.
uncertainties: Inline permittivity does not reproduce the mid-run split (R02 clean peak 12.392 pF/cm vs R01 flat-topped max 12.7876 pF/cm with 0.0 dropouts and 'Warning Active' statuses), so an offline sampling/analysis artifact is not excluded (H-5 vs H-6).
Offline sample times were not readable; row index used as ordering proxy.

interpretations.statement: EXP011/R02 suffered a catastrophic viability collapse between consecutive offline samples: viability 90.78% at row 8 fell to 38.47% at the t=67 h sample, with TCD jumping to 4.05e6 cells/mL, aggregation to 25.3%, glucose crashing 5.85 -> 0.99 g/L and ammonium 2.86 -> 11.49 mM; viability was 1.65% at the next sample and VCD reached 0 by t=148.5 h while TCD remained ~6.7e6 and ammonium kept climbing to 48.93 mM. The twin R01 grew to 5.95e6 and declined only late (end viability 9.47%).
uncertainties: The ammonium 48.93 mM source cell was verified by a child investigator (source integrity true), but +46 mM ammonium is difficult to reconcile with the small osmolality rise (295 -> 337 mOsm/kg), leaving a possible analyzer/sample-prep bias unresolved.
The row-8 sample time was not extracted; failure onset is bracketed between row 8 and t=67 h.

interpretations.statement: EXP011/R02 shows a coherent gas-control anomaly versus its twin: dissolved CO2 reached 63.85 %-sat at t=193.2 h (verified against source hash by the lead), was chronically elevated pre-collapse (max 20.87 %-sat before t~67 h vs R01 whole-run max 16.01), and exceeded 60 %-sat for a sustained late-run window; CO2 inlet fraction reached 52.394% (t~195.6 h) with a 43.0% excursion at t~66.9 h near the collapse; inline permittivity independently corroborates the low biomass (R02 peak 4.14 vs R01 7.99 pF/cm). Child-reported (unverified): pH band up-shifted (7.014-7.066 vs 6.958-7.029) with near-zero NaOH base addition (1.74 g vs 55.79 g) and DO depressed (avg 23.8 vs 72.5).
uncertainties: The most extreme gas values post-date the collapse (VCD=0 at t=148.5 h), so they may be consequences (post-death control/probe behavior) rather than causes; only the t~66.9 h CO2-inlet excursion temporally coincides with failure onset.
DO/pH/NaOH specifics are child-returned rows or provenance-unresolved aggregates, not independently verified against source hashes (budget exhausted).

A low-biomass culture should show HIGH dissolved O2 (twin averaged 72.5%); the recorded low DO is internally inconsistent in both causal directions, which keeps both sensor-fault and real-gas-fault hypotheses alive.

interpretations.statement: Feed delivery to EXP011/R02 was only ~5% of its twin: child-reported cumulative-feed maxima are 11.43 g (R02) vs 228.53 g (R01) (EXP010: 857/817 g; EXP012: 274/282 g), and EXP011/R02's own feed log ends at t~67 h (8054 records ~ 67 h at the ~120 rows/h rate calibrated from returned feed rows at t=8.32 h), coinciding with the viability collapse. R02 osmolality stayed nearly flat (295 -> 337 mOsm/kg) while R01 climbed to 465 as feed accumulated.
uncertainties: The 11.43 g vs 228.53 g figures are child-run aggregates without citable row ids; the lead could not pull feed rows before the tool budget was exhausted.
Causality is unresolved: the feed may have been stopped because the culture died (reverse causality); no feed-plan, pump, line, or scale records are in the evidence package.
The t~67 h end-of-log estimate is inferred from row-rate calibration, not a measured timestamp.

interpretations.statement: EXP008 is an experiment-level low-growth anomaly: both reactors agree closely yet plateau at the lowest peaks of all 24 cultivations (R01 3.77-3.79e6, R02 4.07e6 cells/mL) with the earliest batch glucose exhaustion (1.165 and 0.2635 g/L at row 8) and the highest batch lactate (4.12 and 4.095 g/L) - roughly 4x poorer biomass-per-glucose yield than EXP001/R01 (14.0e6 on similar starting glucose). Ammonium stayed within the batch range (8.41 mM), and inline permittivity (6.01 vs 6.06 pF/cm, child-returned) independently confirms the low biomass.
uncertainties: Glucose columns stop at row 8 of 17 in EXP008 - last recorded, not necessarily final state.
No medium-lot, seed, or protocol-difference records are available to separate designed from unintended causes.

interpretations.statement: Between-experiment variability is partly process-design-driven: batch runs (EXP001-009) show no feed accumulation (child-reported aggregate: cumulative feed 0 g for all 18 batch reactors) and deplete glucose, while fed-batch runs accumulate osmolality (EXP010/R01 to 511 mOsm/kg), lactate (EXP011/R01 8.58 g/L) and ammonium (EXP010/R01 13.68 mM) and reach the highest peaks (EXP010: 16.07/16.17e6 cells/mL).
uncertainties: Feed totals for batch runs are child-reported provenance-unresolved aggregates; the only feed observation the lead holds directly is 0 g at t=8.32 h (EXP011/R02).
No DoE/protocol plan is in the evidence package, so 'designed' differences are inferred from setpoint/feeding patterns.
Within-group spread remains unexplained (EXP001 14.0e6 vs EXP008 3.8e6 within the batch group).

interpretations.statement: Independent data-quality defects exist in inline/lab channels and do not by themselves explain the growth differences: EXP001/R01 permittivity logged 'Warning Active' statuses and a flat-topped maximum (12.7876 pF/cm identical across consecutive rows) with exact-0.0 dropouts (also at run end, matching the offline terminal crash), EXP001/R01 osmolality dips to 154 mOsm/kg, and (child-reported aggregates) DeltaEps is flat 0 for EXP001-003 R02 units while EXP001/R01 added 2.46-2.52 g NaOH vs 0.09 g in R02. No 'Fault' records were found; sampled statuses are 'Ok'.
uncertainties: 'Warning Active' inventory is incomplete (search capped at 100 records, all in EXP001/R01 permittivity rows 100-199).
DeltaEps=0 and NaOH figures are provenance-unresolved aggregates or child-returned rows, unverified.
NaOH asymmetry also occurs in non-diverging pairs (child: EXP002 0.64 vs 0.02 g; EXP004 13.4 vs 45.5 g), so it is not a divergence marker.
Turbidity transmission is unusable as an arbiter (R02 sensors read >1.0 arb. units with exact-0.0 spikes, child finding).

causal_hypotheses.statement: EXP011/R02 collapsed because feed delivery failed (pump/line/scale fault or setup error): cumulative feed reached only 11.43 g vs 228.53 g in the twin, the feed log ends at t~67 h coinciding with the crash, osmolality stayed flat, and glucose crashed to 0.99 g/L at the failure sample.
unknowns: Actual delivered volumes and feed-plan vs actual records are absent.
Whether the feed was stopped because the culture died (reverse causality).
Whether ~11-24 h of starvation can plausibly kill ~90% of cells that fast.
tests_or_observations_that_would_discrim: Review feed pump/line/scale records and feed plan for EXP011.
Pull the full feed-weight series with citable row ids and true timestamps.
Re-assay retained EXP011/R02 samples for glucose/osmolality.

causal_hypotheses.statement: EXP011/R02 collapsed because of the gas-control anomaly (chronic CO2 loading and O2 displacement): dissolved CO2 stayed >=9.85 %-sat all run (vs twin max 16.01), CO2 inlet fraction hit 43% at t~66.9 h and 52.4% max, DO was depressed, and the culture grew normally for the first ~56 h then died when the anomaly intensified.
unknowns: Recorded pH never left ~7.01-7.07 despite massive CO2 addition with near-zero base (child-reported) - either probes over-read or CO2 was deliberately added for pH control; cannot distinguish.
Whether dCO2/DO probe readings are trustworthy (no calibration records in package).
The most extreme gas values post-date the collapse.
tests_or_observations_that_would_discrim: Audit the CO2/NaOH pH-control loop configuration and probe calibrations for EXP011 R01 vs R02.
Check gas-mixer logs and aeration setpoints/recipes.
Cross-check inline dCO2 against offline bicarbonate measurements.

causal_hypotheses.statement: EXP011/R02 collapsed due to a biological event at ~t=67 h (contamination, or a toxic component in an R02-specific medium/feed aliquot): the crash was abrupt (90.78% -> 38.47% viability in one interval), TCD spiked while VCD fell (dead cells retained), aggregation jumped to 25-37%, and ammonium climbed steadily to 48.9 mM consistent with ongoing lysis.
unknowns: No sterility, endotoxin, or contamination records in the package.
R01 shared the presumed same medium lot and remained healthy until its own late decline.
The ammonium-osmolality tension (H-4) leaves the lysis reading uncertain.
tests_or_observations_that_would_discrim: Retrieve sterility/endotoxin and medium/feed lot documentation for EXP011.
Independent re-assay of retained R02 samples (ammonium, glucose, osmolality, lactate dehydrogenase).

causal_hypotheses.statement: Key EXP011/R02 readings are measurement artifacts (probe miscalibration/fouling after death, or analyzer/sample-prep bias): the extreme dCO2/DO values post-date the collapse, 48.9 mM ammonium is inconsistent with the small osmolality rise, and a low-biomass culture physiologically should show HIGH dissolved O2 (twin averaged 72.5%) rather than the recorded 23.8%.
unknowns: Chronic pre-collapse dCO2 elevation (>=9.85 %-sat from the start) cannot be explained by post-death fouling alone.
Inline permittivity independently corroborates the low biomass, so the failure itself is not an artifact.
Whether multiple channels (DO, dCO2, CO2 inlet, NaOH, ammonium) could be wrong in a mutually coherent way.
tests_or_observations_that_would_discrim: Retrieve probe calibration/maintenance records for EXP011 R01/R02.
Independent re-assay of retained samples (ammonium, osmolality, bicarbonate).

causal_hypotheses.statement: EXP001's 65% duplicate divergence is genuine biological variability (e.g., seed/inoculum state or growth-rate difference): R01 grew ~2x faster throughout (14.0e6 vs 5.4e6 at the same sample index), starved on glucose and died, while R02 grew slower and survived; metabolite profiles were similar and (child analysis) pH, temperature, dCO2 and NaOH asymmetries do not separate the pair (NaOH asymmetry also occurs in non-diverging pairs).
unknowns: No inoculum/seed records (vial, passage, seeding density/viability) in the package.
Inline arbiter is compromised for EXP001 (R01 permittivity saturated with warnings), so inline neither confirms nor refutes.
Expected permittivity for 14e6 cells (~15.6-20 pF/cm, child estimate) exceeds the observed 12.79 rail.
tests_or_observations_that_would_discrim: Recount retained EXP001 samples (rows 8-12) by an independent method.
Pull permittivity at identical rows during divergence onset (below the saturation rail).

causal_hypotheses.statement: EXP001's duplicate divergence is an offline sampling/analysis artifact (cell-counter, dilution, or sampling bias affecting VCD and TCD coherently): inline permittivity peaks are nearly equal (R01 12.7876 saturated vs R02 12.392 pF/cm) and do not reproduce the 1.65-2.6x offline split, and EXP001 shows other analyzer anomalies (osmolality dip to 154 mOsm/kg).
unknowns: An artifact would need to affect VCD, TCD and viability trajectories coherently across many samples.
R01's terminal crash is corroborated inline (permittivity exact 0.0 at run end), showing the channel tracked biomass when not saturated.
R01's glucose starvation and death vs R02's survival are consistent physiological consequences of a real growth-rate difference.
tests_or_observations_that_would_discrim: Recount retained EXP001 samples with an independent counter/operator.
Audit cell-counter calibration and dilution records for EXP001 sampling days.

causal_hypotheses.statement: EXP008's low-growth plateau is an experiment-level factor shared by both reactors (medium lot, seed state, or protocol handling): both reactors agree closely at 3.8-4.1e6 cells/mL with the highest batch lactate (4.12/4.10 g/L), earliest glucose exhaustion and ~4x poorer biomass-per-glucose yield, while ammonium stayed normal.
unknowns: No medium-lot, seed-passage, or prep records available.
EXP009/011/012 share the high starting osmolality (320-330, child-reported) but reached 5.9-8.0e6, so start osmolality alone does not explain the plateau.
Setpoints match EXP007/009 (aggregates), which grew to 7.9-11.4e6.
tests_or_observations_that_would_discrim: Compare medium lot/preparation records for EXP008 vs EXP007/009.
Check cell-bank passage history and thaw records for EXP008.

causal_hypotheses.statement: Between-experiment variability is largely designed (batch vs fed-batch strategy plus differing aeration/agitation setpoints by experiment group), explaining most of the peak-VCD spread across experiments: fed-batch runs received feed and reached 16.1e6 with osmolality to 511 mOsm/kg; batch runs received no feed and deplete glucose.
unknowns: No DoE/protocol plan is in the evidence package; 'designed' is inferred from setpoint/feeding patterns (provenance-unresolved aggregates).
Designed factors do not explain within-run duplicate divergence (EXP001) or the EXP011/R02 death.
tests_or_observations_that_would_discrim: Obtain the DoE/protocol plan and setpoint tables for EXP001-012.

open_questions: What was actually delivered to EXP011/R02's feed line - pump/line/scale records, feed plan vs actual, and why does the feed log end at t~67 h?
Are EXP011/R02's dissolved-CO2, DO, and pH readings trustworthy (calibration/offset/fouling records)?
Is the 48.93 mM ammonium in EXP011/R02 real or an analyzer/sample-prep bias (osmolality tension)?
Did EXP001 R01 and R02 differ at inoculation (vial, passage, seeding density/viability)?
What caused EXP008's poor biomass-per-glucose yield in both reactors (medium lot, seed, handling)?
Is there a DoE/protocol document explaining the aeration/agitation/feed differences between experiment groups?
Why do offline observations carry no occurred_at timestamps in the numeric projection, and can true sampling times be recovered for all runs?
What is the complete 'Warning Active' status inventory across all 12 sources (search was capped at 100 records)?
Why do R02 turbidity transmission sensors read >1.0 arb. units with exact-0.0 spikes (child finding) - are transmission channels comparable across reactors?
EXP001 cross-method conflict: inline permittivity (saturated arbiter) does not reproduce the offline 1.65-2.6x duplicate divergence - which method is right?

workflow.objective: Investigate cultivation variability with supporting and contradictory evidence and competing hypotheses; do not assert proven causes.

interpretations.statement: Independent data-quality defects exist in inline/lab channels and do not by themselves explain the growth differences: EXP001/R01 permittivity logged 'Warning Active' statuses and a flat-topped maximum (12.7876 pF/cm identical across consecutive rows) with exact-0.0 dropouts (also at run end, matching the offline terminal crash), EXP001/R01 osmolality dips to 154 mOsm/kg, and (child-reported aggregates) DeltaEps is flat 0 for EXP001-003 R02 units while EXP001/R01 added 2.46-2.52 g NaOH vs 0.09 g in R02. No 'Fault' records were found; sampled statuses are 'Ok'.
uncertainties: 'Warning Active' inventory is incomplete (search capped at 100 records, all in EXP001/R01 permittivity rows 100-199).
DeltaEps=0 and NaOH figures are provenance-unresolved aggregates or child-returned rows, unverified.
NaOH asymmetry also occurs in non-diverging pairs (child: EXP002 0.64 vs 0.02 g; EXP004 13.4 vs 45.5 g), so it is not a divergence marker.
Turbidity transmission is unusable as an arbiter (R02 sensors read >1.0 arb. units with exact-0.0 spikes, child finding).

evidence_scope.basis: cited_evidence_coverage; affected units require explicit adjudication
evidence_scope.hierarchy_status: experiment groups are candidates inferred from source run hierarchy

hypothesis_tests.statement: EXP011/R02 collapsed because feed delivery failed (pump/line/scale fault or setup error): cumulative feed reached only 11.43 g vs 228.53 g in the twin, the feed log ends at t~67 h coinciding with the crash, osmolality stayed flat, and glucose crashed to 0.99 g/L at the failure sample.
unknowns: Actual delivered volumes and feed-plan vs actual records are absent.
Whether the feed was stopped because the culture died (reverse causality).
Whether ~11-24 h of starvation can plausibly kill ~90% of cells that fast.
discriminating_tests: Review feed pump/line/scale records and feed plan for EXP011.
Pull the full feed-weight series with citable row ids and true timestamps.
Re-assay retained EXP011/R02 samples for glucose/osmolality.

hypothesis_tests.statement: EXP011/R02 collapsed because of the gas-control anomaly (chronic CO2 loading and O2 displacement): dissolved CO2 stayed >=9.85 %-sat all run (vs twin max 16.01), CO2 inlet fraction hit 43% at t~66.9 h and 52.4% max, DO was depressed, and the culture grew normally for the first ~56 h then died when the anomaly intensified.
unknowns: Recorded pH never left ~7.01-7.07 despite massive CO2 addition with near-zero base (child-reported) - either probes over-read or CO2 was deliberately added for pH control; cannot distinguish.
Whether dCO2/DO probe readings are trustworthy (no calibration records in package).
The most extreme gas values post-date the collapse.
discriminating_tests: Audit the CO2/NaOH pH-control loop configuration and probe calibrations for EXP011 R01 vs R02.
Check gas-mixer logs and aeration setpoints/recipes.
Cross-check inline dCO2 against offline bicarbonate measurements.

hypothesis_tests.statement: EXP011/R02 collapsed due to a biological event at ~t=67 h (contamination, or a toxic component in an R02-specific medium/feed aliquot): the crash was abrupt (90.78% -> 38.47% viability in one interval), TCD spiked while VCD fell (dead cells retained), aggregation jumped to 25-37%, and ammonium climbed steadily to 48.9 mM consistent with ongoing lysis.
unknowns: No sterility, endotoxin, or contamination records in the package.
R01 shared the presumed same medium lot and remained healthy until its own late decline.
The ammonium-osmolality tension (H-4) leaves the lysis reading uncertain.
discriminating_tests: Retrieve sterility/endotoxin and medium/feed lot documentation for EXP011.
Independent re-assay of retained R02 samples (ammonium, glucose, osmolality, lactate dehydrogenase).

hypothesis_tests.statement: Key EXP011/R02 readings are measurement artifacts (probe miscalibration/fouling after death, or analyzer/sample-prep bias): the extreme dCO2/DO values post-date the collapse, 48.9 mM ammonium is inconsistent with the small osmolality rise, and a low-biomass culture physiologically should show HIGH dissolved O2 (twin averaged 72.5%) rather than the recorded 23.8%.
unknowns: Chronic pre-collapse dCO2 elevation (>=9.85 %-sat from the start) cannot be explained by post-death fouling alone.
Inline permittivity independently corroborates the low biomass, so the failure itself is not an artifact.
Whether multiple channels (DO, dCO2, CO2 inlet, NaOH, ammonium) could be wrong in a mutually coherent way.
discriminating_tests: Retrieve probe calibration/maintenance records for EXP011 R01/R02.
Independent re-assay of retained samples (ammonium, osmolality, bicarbonate).

hypothesis_tests.statement: EXP001's 65% duplicate divergence is genuine biological variability (e.g., seed/inoculum state or growth-rate difference): R01 grew ~2x faster throughout (14.0e6 vs 5.4e6 at the same sample index), starved on glucose and died, while R02 grew slower and survived; metabolite profiles were similar and (child analysis) pH, temperature, dCO2 and NaOH asymmetries do not separate the pair (NaOH asymmetry also occurs in non-diverging pairs).
unknowns: No inoculum/seed records (vial, passage, seeding density/viability) in the package.
Inline arbiter is compromised for EXP001 (R01 permittivity saturated with warnings), so inline neither confirms nor refutes.
Expected permittivity for 14e6 cells (~15.6-20 pF/cm, child estimate) exceeds the observed 12.79 rail.
discriminating_tests: Recount retained EXP001 samples (rows 8-12) by an independent method.
Pull permittivity at identical rows during divergence onset (below the saturation rail).

hypothesis_tests.statement: EXP001's duplicate divergence is an offline sampling/analysis artifact (cell-counter, dilution, or sampling bias affecting VCD and TCD coherently): inline permittivity peaks are nearly equal (R01 12.7876 saturated vs R02 12.392 pF/cm) and do not reproduce the 1.65-2.6x offline split, and EXP001 shows other analyzer anomalies (osmolality dip to 154 mOsm/kg).
unknowns: An artifact would need to affect VCD, TCD and viability trajectories coherently across many samples.
R01's terminal crash is corroborated inline (permittivity exact 0.0 at run end), showing the channel tracked biomass when not saturated.
R01's glucose starvation and death vs R02's survival are consistent physiological consequences of a real growth-rate difference.
discriminating_tests: Recount retained EXP001 samples with an independent counter/operator.
Audit cell-counter calibration and dilution records for EXP001 sampling days.

hypothesis_tests.statement: EXP008's low-growth plateau is an experiment-level factor shared by both reactors (medium lot, seed state, or protocol handling): both reactors agree closely at 3.8-4.1e6 cells/mL with the highest batch lactate (4.12/4.10 g/L), earliest glucose exhaustion and ~4x poorer biomass-per-glucose yield, while ammonium stayed normal.
unknowns: No medium-lot, seed-passage, or prep records available.
EXP009/011/012 share the high starting osmolality (320-330, child-reported) but reached 5.9-8.0e6, so start osmolality alone does not explain the plateau.
Setpoints match EXP007/009 (aggregates), which grew to 7.9-11.4e6.
discriminating_tests: Compare medium lot/preparation records for EXP008 vs EXP007/009.
Check cell-bank passage history and thaw records for EXP008.

hypothesis_tests.statement: Between-experiment variability is largely designed (batch vs fed-batch strategy plus differing aeration/agitation setpoints by experiment group), explaining most of the peak-VCD spread across experiments: fed-batch runs received feed and reached 16.1e6 with osmolality to 511 mOsm/kg; batch runs received no feed and deplete glucose.
unknowns: No DoE/protocol plan is in the evidence package; 'designed' is inferred from setpoint/feeding patterns (provenance-unresolved aggregates).
Designed factors do not explain within-run duplicate divergence (EXP001) or the EXP011/R02 death.
discriminating_tests: Obtain the DoE/protocol plan and setpoint tables for EXP001-012.
